history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the United Nations Procurement Manual and associated guidance material to clarify the circumstances in which delegated authority can be exercised and to indicate the criteria to be applied to determine when issues should be referred to a higher body.
history.administration_response: The Administration found that the most relevant document in which such guidance should be included is the “document processing authority”, attached to the delegation of procurement authority granted by the Assistant Secretary-General for Central Support Services. On 14 August 2015, the document processing authority for the Procurement Division was revised to clarify how to process contracts and purchase orders amendments on the basis of the nature of the amendment itself. The document processing authority for the Department of Field Support is still being updated.
history.board_assessment: The review of delegated authority and revision of process of issuing amendments to contracts/ purchase orders on the basis of their nature is a welcome step, but that is not sufficient in itself. The role of contract review committees needs to be clarified and strengthened. Furthermore, there is another outstanding recommendation (see A/67/5 (Vol. I), chap. II, para. 130) where review of delegations granted to the United Nations Office at Vienna and the United Nations Office at Geneva is still in progress. On this basis, the recommendation remains under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration review the United Nations Procurement Manual and associated guidance material to clarify the circumstances in which delegated authority can be exercised and to indicate the criteria to be applied to determine when issues should be referred to a higher body.
history.administration_response: The Administration reviewed the recommendation with a view to issuing guidance as appropriate on contract amendments. It became apparent, however, that the most relevant document in which such guidance should be included is the document processing authority attached to the delegation of procurement authority granted by the Assistant Secretary-General for Central Support Services, which is referenced in the Procurement Manual and provided to all buyers. Accordingly, on 14 August 2015 the document processing authority for the Procurement Division was revised to clarify how to process contract/purchase order amendments based on the nature of the amendment itself. The document processing authority for the Department of Field Support is being updated accordingly.
history.board_assessment: The findings related to the Procurement Division. The document processing authority has been updated, and thus the recommendation is considered implemented.
